style.backgroundSystem: pure white #FFFFFF for infographic and variant screens, deep storm charcoal #2E3238 for the energy hero, deep teal #2FA893 for the closing screen

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent high-energy urban mobility ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, deep storm charcoal #2E3238, mid neutral grey #8A8D91 and one teal accent #2FA893; cool-toned lighting with dramatic directional key on hero shots and bright even studio light on infographic shots; modern geometric sans-serif with bold italic display headlines for energy shots; consistent rounded rectangular info labels and thin-line icons; clean commercial product photography mixed with minimal infographic bands; stable product scale and centered placement with clean even margins on all info screens; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable product scale and centered placement; hero energy angle reserved for opening and closing shots; strict 90-degree side profile for variant and silhouette screens
style.surfaceSystem: asphalt road #3A3D40 for energy shots, clean studio floor with light grey band #EDEDEB for packshot screens
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; bold italic display treatment for energy headlines; short bold labels and callouts throughout
